content.text: Find & Date Singles Near You Only for iPhone Free · In‑App Purchases Match – The Dating App for Real Relationships and Real People. Looking for something real? Welcome to Match – the dating app designed for singles who know what they want. For over 25 years, Match has helped millions of men and women find meaningful relationships through authentic conversations, expert-backed guidance, and a safe, trusted platform. Whether you're searching for love, exploring local dating, or ready to meet someone new, Match makes it easy to connect with real people near you who are looking for the same thing. We believe being honest about who you are and what you’re looking for isn’t being picky – it’s being confident. Match is here to help you date like an adult: with intention, clarity, and the tools to make meaningful connections. Why Match Stands Out Match goes beyond swipes and surface-level chats. It’s a dating experience built on trust, safety, and real human connection. - Real Singles, Serious Intentions: Our members are here to find something meaningful – not just kill time. - Expert Dating Support: From profile tips to first date advice, our team of dating experts is here to help. - Verified Profiles: We take safety seriously, so you can focus on getting to know people without second guessing. - Advanced Matching Tools: Get specific with your preferences and discover matches that really align with your goals. Features Designed for Real Connections - Customized Search Filters: Set your criteria and explore singles who meet your relationship goals. - Conversation Starters: From trending topics to easy prompts, Match helps you break the ice effortlessly. - Local Events – Online & IRL: Meet singles in your area at fun, low-pressure events designed to make dating easier. - Expert Tips & Insights: Optimize your profile and improve your approach with advice from real dating professionals. - Safe, Verified Community: Every profile goes through checks to help keep the platform authentic and respectful. Free to Start, Easy to Explore It’s free to download and start matching right away. With no subscription required, you can: - Create your profile and upload photos - Browse and receive daily match suggestions - Chat with recommended matches - Join virtual and in-person singles events Want more control and visibility? Go Premium. Unlock exclusive tools and benefits: - See unlimited profiles - Use advanced filters to find exactly what you're looking for - Reconnect with profiles you passed on - Boost your profile to get seen faster - Get premium-level dating advice and tips Whether you’re looking for a serious relationship or just want to meet quality singles near you, Match gives you the tools and confidence to make it happen. Real people. Real relationships. Real dating. Join Match today and discover a dating experience that’s honest, safe, and made for adults who are done playing games. Download Match and start connecting – it’s free to try. All photos are of models and used for illustrative purposes only. This app has some of the best quality matches that I have encountered. As far as quality women, this app seems to be the cream of the crop. One problem that I will start with is that I am not allowed to receive notifications. I have gone into the settings on my phone multiple times, I have checked the app for Settings and I looked into troubleshooting this but there has been no clearcut definitive answer or solution. The payment plan is to high for most people, at least middle class college students who work full time. If I could afford to upgrade I certainly would for the premium perks. I met one of the most beautiful and incredible women I’ve ever encountered through this app, she lives in NC , I’m in SC. We are taking it slow and developing a mature friendship that is Christ centered with no expectations that could weigh down the power of the connection. She used to be a runway model and I was just offered an opportunity to do my first shoot. My number one piece of advice to anyone using this app or any other App is to guard your heart, guard your mind and when you meet the right person they will be more than willing to earn your trust over time and let their actions speak louder than their words. Match is really a great dating app and probably is the best bang for your buck if you can afford it but as I mentioned before the only premium plans worth having are for 6 months and 12 months. I can’t add that into my budget right now in good conscious but aside from that and not being able to get notifications I like it a lot. Developer ResponseHi there, we appreciate very much that you reviewed our app! We are very sorry to hear the inconvenience you had with the notifications of our app. If the problem persists, please reach out to us at appreviews@support.match.com. Rest assured that we will do our best to find a solution to your concern. We also appreciate feedback on our subscription pricing. We want you to know that we provide our users with free trials and often discounts. Feel free to let us know in your email that you would like to get more information about our promotions or about getting a free trial. It also makes us very happy that you shared the experience you had in Match. We love it when our users meet people and have a special connection. 💙 Hi I just met with Jennifer the dating coach all my God it was such a awesome meeting with her I had 30 minutes I spent about 50 bucks and it was well worth it guys if you’re looking to enhance your dating life and you’re wondering why you’re not getting any message messages back you’re wondering why these girls aren’t responding to your text messages you think maybe your luxe aren’t that good or you don’t know what’s going on I would seriously call Jennifer the dating coach she’s one of the best dating coaches on there she’s been doing this for a long time guys if you want some honest feedback she will definitely be the girl for the job she open my eyes are so much staff in the little time I met with her she was an amazing amazing godson in my life since I’ve talk to her seriously and taking her advice and applied everything she said I’ve had 10 dates and I’ve had probably 50% of my messages are being replied to buy these women before it was zero if you want life-changing changes in your life regarding your daily life you have got to call Jennifer just pick up the phone it’s not gonna take much time out of your day it’s 30 minutes it’s barely any money you know you can afford it you’ve already paid for the dating app let’s not discuss whether you can afford it or not it’s whether you’re willing to invest in your time yourself in your life because she’s willing to invest in the part that you’re not willing to invest please call Jennifer she will make all your dreams become reality thank you Developer ResponseHi! Thank you for your review! It's always a pleasure to receive nice comments – it means we're on the right track! We'll do our best to continue with the positive vibes! Stay with us to see all positive changes. Beware, like seriously beware. Match has you to sign up, create a profile, answer some questions, and upload your photos. Match does all of this without disclosing they charge you if you respond to a message you sent to someone they supposedly match with you. There’s more to this review, read it fully. I want you all to seriously research this app and please be cautious at every step. Once your profile is set up you will be sent a few random likes/matches who you can’t see and magically you will be able to respond to those likes/matches, however they are not real individuals. Your responses will go unanswered. You will soon realize the profiles are not active users and the ones that are number into the teens. They advertise millions of users, they really mean millions of users signed up and realized it was a scam and ditched the site. You are left with liking profiles that haven’t been active for years. Then you wake up one morning like I did and see your account is charged over a hundred dollars. Apple fixed this for me and when I went to delete the account guess what happened; magically there were two new matches or likes which were not there before and the matches photos were hidden. The photos were not there minutes before Apple refunded to my account those fraudulent chargers. I literally watched this scam in real time. This is a scam and I can see a class action lawsuit in the near future for this website. Stay away! Developer ResponseHello there! Thank you for bringing this issue to our attention. Please note that Match does not charge users for responding to messages they send to others. We take these allegations seriously and would like to investigate further. Could you please provide us with more details, such as your account information and any screenshots or evidence you may have to appreviews@support.match.com with the subject line MIE0810? This will help us address the situation and ensure a positive experience for our users.
